fields.label: Size (Batch)
fields.description: Sizes are batch allocations in Tally: the batch name IS the size, e.g. "28" or "XL".

fields.label: Delivered
fields.description: Computed at sync from invoice (and delivery-note) lines that quote this order number for this item and size. Tally holds no reliable per-size fulfilment figure in this book.

fields.label: Pre-closed Qty
fields.description: Quantity the order was closed short by, when this build exports it. Zero otherwise — never guessed.

fields.label: Rate Unit
fields.description: May differ from the quantity unit, so amount is never recomputed as qty x rate.

fields.label: Discount %
fields.description: First step of the chain, as Tally records it (50 in this book).

fields.label: Second Discount %
fields.description: Second step, held in Tally's BatchDiscount2 UDF (20 in this book). Storing only the first step misprices every line.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Net of the full discount chain, exactly as Tally exports it.

fields.label: Due Date
fields.description: Per size — Tally carries the due date on the batch allocation, not on the item line.
